scope: Bundesliga and La Liga automatic synchronisation (OpenLigaDB, every 6 hours, each league on its own schedule)
duties: run the daily audit (scripts\ops\footiq_service.ps1 audit) and read its report
review the unresolved sync findings in the quarantine (docs/mini-project/phase4/QUARANTINE_REVIEW_PROCEDURE.md)
decide whether a changed database state becomes the next baseline checkpoint (baseline_monitor.py approve ... --by <name>)
switch synchronisation off at the first sign of unexpected changes (docs/mini-project/phase4/P4_8D_ACTIVATION_CHECKLIST.md, section 6)
note: Nothing in FootIQ approves a checkpoint or resolves a quarantined finding by itself; only this person does.
